title: Writing --- My Own Line
label: ch:pt-my-own-line
canDo: I can write one line about myself from a closed supply of known words, with nothing to copy, and put every accent and til on.

payoff.summary: Complete PT-W256-my-own-line: name, home and language, chosen rather than copied, with the marks checked before anything else.
payoff.note: The first writing step with nothing to reach for. The Portuguese-specific check arrives with it: the til is not an accent but a nasal sign, and a hand that writes pao for pão has written a word Portuguese does not have.
